target: Fig. 2(d), labeled D in arXiv; main Eqs. (3), (4), (6); SM VI and Fig. 5
precision: The critical values are rounded published NRG estimates, not exact analytical constants; no uncertainty or raw numerical array was supplied.
phase_map: The paper colors the analytic geometric factor using its NRG critical value. Our map uses the independently calculated critical value.
analytic_reference: Identical BCS baths: chi=abs(sum gamma_j exp(i phi_j)); phi_eff=2 arccos(chi); J_j=(2e/hbar)(dE/dchi)(dchi/dphi_j).
